purpose: One registry for composable bounded transformations across UI, agents, HOUSE/HAOS and physical return. Preserve mechanisms; do not create parallel pipelines.

lineage.rule: Recover donor semantics; current registry is a new composition layer, not a claim that historical code implemented current behavior.

laws: IDENTITY survives projection unless a declared transform creates a new object.
OBSERVATION may refine a candidate default; it may not grant authority.
COMPOSITION preserves each member's authority ceiling.
NO RECURSION WITHOUT DELTA OR NEW EVIDENCE.
A failed/ambiguous transform returns residue instead of silently selecting another goal.
Consequential external action requires explicit or pre-delegated bounded authority.
SUPPORT=0 remains inspectable; support is possibility evidence, never authority.
Typed composition rejects an incompatible next transform instead of silently coercing to a nearest state.

transductions.focus: action metadata only; never payload text

transductions.observable: candidate default after >=3 observations and >=0.60 share

transductions.commit: artifact + RETURN when pass criteria hold

transductions.focus: explicit scale + position inside the source
transductions.transform: project whole source into addressed focus without replacing canonical source
transductions.commit: none; focus is reversible view state
transductions.evidence: focus scale + index + address; payload remains session-local
transductions.reversibility: instant WHOLE/FOCUS switch or aperture movement

transductions.source: current Port route scope (whole or focus)
transductions.transform: count explicit lexical cues + derive low-risk likely route
transductions.observable: per-route cue counts + LIKELY suggestion; zero-support routes stay available
transductions.evidence: cue counts + candidate accept/override + content-free route receipt
transductions.note: HUMAN PORT 1.5 separates structural FIT from heuristic CUES and local HISTORY; retain as provenance only.

transductions.source: addressed object + current projection contract + ordered LensState stack
transductions.focus: one candidate VIEW_LENS or ACTION_TOOLGLASS descriptor
transductions.transform: evaluate inputContract against current ordered output contract; expose support=1 or support=0 + reason; compose only when supported
transductions.commit: VIEW_LENS: none / preview only; ACTION_TOOLGLASS: only with explicit COMMIT authority and receipt
transductions.observable: ordered projection stack + current contract + lawful/dead next candidates
transductions.evidence: LensState serialization + support result + sourceRefs + returnAddress; CI law receipt
transductions.authority: VIEW_ONLY unless an explicit ACTION_TOOLGLASS declares bounded COMMIT authority
transductions.reversibility: uncompose/RETURN for view state; consequential rollback is compensating RETURN, never history erasure

transductions.transform: exact contract lookup → DIRECT / ADAPTER / NONE
transductions.observable: structural ability of a route to consume this projection

transductions.evidence: cue count only; never called confidence

compositions.note: Preference evidence tunes presentation only; no authority escalation.
May repeat only under an explicit bounded recurrence contract; otherwise stop after one consequential delta.
HUMAN PORT 1.5: one addressed object survives unequal projections. FIT/CUES/HISTORY remain separate; authority is never derived from them. FIELD INTAKE is the reviewed admission boundary.

One FIELD route identity survives AXIAL selection, aperture/projection changes and Studio handoff. AXIAL source-support and Lens type-support remain distinct calculations under the shared law that dead states stay visible and support never grants authority.
